Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 의뢰를 성공한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 자신의 일처리에 만족스러워 한다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After a successful quest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> was pleased with how smoothly she handled the task.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼を成功させた<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、自分の仕事ぶりに満足しているようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 成功完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>对自己的表现感到满意。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 成功完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>對自己的表現感到滿意。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Après avoir mené à bien la mission, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> est satisfaite de son travail.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss des Auftrags war <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mit ihrer Arbeit zufrieden.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Después de completar la misión con éxito, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> está satisfecha con su desempeño.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> concluiu a missão com sucesso e está satisfeita com o próprio trabalho.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ที่ทำภารกิจสำเร็จ รู้สึกพึงพอใจกับการทำงานของตัวเอง
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> puas dengan kinerjanya setelah berhasil menyelesaikan misi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sau khi hoàn thành nhiệm vụ thành công, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hài lòng với cách mình đã xử lý.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने सफलतापूर्वक कार्य पूरा किया और अपने काम से संतुष्ट थी।
